LESSON PLAN CREATIVE ARTS ACTIVITIES
 Week: Lesson:
 SCHOOL GRADE DATE TIME ROLL
 TWO
STRAND: SCULPTURE
SUB STRAND: FORMS: Toys: Making simple Toys of Houses.
SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES
By the end of the lessons, the learner should be able to:-
 1. Observe samples of toys, materials and tools from teacher’s collection and or digital media to motivate them make
 their own.
 2. Collect different types of tools from the environment that can be used to make toys.
 3. Make simple toys of houses using locally available materials and tools to play with for fun.
 4. Display and discuss their toys for self-efficiency.
KEY INQUIRIES QUESTION
  What toys can you see in the class inquiry corner?
  Which materials and tools are used for constructing and assembling simple toys of house?
  How do you do with toys?
  What do you like about toys of houses?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Communication and collaboration  Respect Self-esteem
  Self-efficacy  Sharing Self-awareness
  Problem solving skills  responsibility
 Health and hygiene
Learning Resources
Sample toys, locally available materials and tools, stick, strings, threat, rubber bands, grass, pieces
of waste clothe, cotton wool, old newspapers,
Waste paper, wire, straws, banana fiber bottle tops, pair of scissor, ICT devices and any other
devices.
KLB Visionary art and craft Grade 2 Teachers Guide pg. 70-76.
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pair/groups.
INTRODUCTION
Review the previous lesson.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT
Step 1: Display to learner’s sample toys, material and tools from your collection.
Step 2: Guide learners to name and discuss different types of toys.
Step 3: Provide learners with materials and tools and Guide learners them to make simple toys.
Step 4: Learners to observe safety precautions when using the items.
SUMMARY
Sculpture is the process or technique of creating three dimensional forms for modelling, carving, molding or
construction.
CONCLUSION
Learners to display their work and talk about others work.
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to collect plastic, bottle tops and old newspapers from the community with the help of parents.
REFLECTION ON THE LESSON/SELF-REMARKS

 TWO
STRAND: SCULPTURE
SUB STRAND: FORMS: Kites: Making simple kites using local materials
SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES
By the end of the lessons, the learner should be able to:-
  Observe sample of kites, locally available materials and tools for making kites at the teacher’s collection for
 motivation.
  Observe kites materials and tools for making kites from the digital media to motivate them make their own.
  Individually explore materials to construct and assemble simple kites.
  Display their simple kites and talk about them in class for appreciation.
KEY INQUIRIES QUESTION
  What materials and tools are used for constructing and assembling kites?
  What safety precautions should be taken as they make the kites?
  How do you play with a kites?
  What time do you fly kites?
  What do you like with the kites you made?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Communication and collaboration  Respect Self-esteem
  Self-efficacy  Sharing Self-awareness
  Problem solving skills  responsibility
 Health and hygiene
  Digital literacy
Learning Resources
Sample kites, old newspaper, magazines, adhesive (pastes glue) ,
Crayons, pieces of curling ribbons, strings, threads, found materials, rubber bands, ICT devices and
any other relevant resources.
KLB Visionary art and craft Grade 2 Teachers Guide pg. 77-82
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pair/groups.
INTRODUCTION
Review the previous lesson.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT
Step 1: Display to learner’s sample of kites, locally available materials and tools for making kites.
Step 2: Guide learners to name and discuss different materials used for making kites.
Step 3: Demonstrate and guide learners in making their own kites.
Step 4: Learners to fly their assembled kites.
Step 5: Learners to observe safety precautions.
SUMMARY
Kites are toys of a light frame with thin material stretched over it.
CONCLUSION
Learners to display their work and talk about others work.
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to collect plastic, bottle tops and old newspapers from the community for use in making kites.
